description: Public Kempner Institute pages on kempnerinstitute.harvard.edu and www.kempnerinstitute.harvard.edu. Each row follows one bounded robots-allowed HTML GET that stayed on these hosts. An unresolved host, HTML or challenge robots.txt, a Cloudflare, cookie, or captcha challenge, or an off-host redirect stores nothing. Rows keep title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. Sole CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, and CC BY-NC-ND keep their tokens. uk_ogl requires the British phrase Open Government Licence. Missing publication dates stay unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired stays false.
